summary: Revoked terminal and exec starts report unverified cleanup on their owning agent instead of faulting on an invalid diagnostic subject.

replay.detail: No graph replay or stored-data migration.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing agent-only diagnostic admission is preserved. Starts without an owning agent log the error without a harness claim; cleanup evidence and retirement safety fences are retained.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous diagnostic targeting behavior.
